# Conformance and support matrix

What the SelfAuth Gin (Go) reference implementation is tested against, which compliance level each
store reaches, and what is not supported. Specification version: **0.1**.

A generator that runs is not a conformant adapter. A level is claimed only
when the cases for it pass in CI and every non-case requirement has a recorded
sign-off with evidence (`conformance/adapters/gin.json`).

## Compliance levels

| Level | Needs | Cases |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Core compliant | all core cases pass; every automated check for core requirements (adapter, schema, migration tests) is signed off | 71 |
| Authorization compliant | core, plus the authorization cases and the authorization checks | 18 |
| Production-profile compliant | all cases, plus every review, documentation and static-analysis item signed off | 1 |

The suite has 90 cases in total.

## Result

| Store | Published level |
| --- | --- |
| memory | Authorization compliant |
| postgresql | Authorization compliant |

**No independent security audit has been done.** Production-profile status is self-assessed from the sign-offs below. An outside review is required before 1.0.

CI runs the whole suite against the in-memory store and against PostgreSQL, and fails if either measures below its published level.

## Support matrix

| Kind | Supported | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| backend | `gin` | Gin 1.12 + Go (a Go port of the core) |
| database | `postgresql` | PostgreSQL via pgx (the same migration SQL as the TypeScript apps; a small migration runner) (store `postgresql`) |
| database | `memory` | In-memory (development and tests only) (store `memory`) |
| frontend | `none` | API only |
| frontend | `vue` | Vue 3 (generated as client/ next to the Go server in server/; browser-tested against the Go server) |
| frontend | `react` | React (generated as client/ next to the Go server in server/; browser-tested against the Go server) |

Not supported yet: see [Known limitations](#known-limitations).

## Known limitations

- Gin supports PostgreSQL and the in-memory store only. MySQL, SQLite and MongoDB are not implemented for Go.
- `selfauth add` does not work on existing Go projects (new projects only). A Vue or React frontend is generated as `client/` next to the Go server in `server/`, and the browser spec runs against the Go server on the in-memory store.
- PostgreSQL is claimed at authorization level, not production: the production profile has not been reviewed for the Go adapter (pool sizing, statement timeouts, behaviour under replica failover were chosen and tested, not audited).
- The in-memory store loses data on restart and keeps rate limits per process. It is capped at authorization level and is not for production.
- The migration runner does not detect destructive statements (unlike `selfauth db plan` for Prisma projects): read every migration before applying it.
- Two implementations of the core now exist. The conformance suite detects drift in the behaviour it covers; behaviour outside the cases is covered by the Go unit tests and review. Known differences (trusted proxies as a list only, simple case folding of email addresses, trailing slashes) are listed in apps/playground-gin/README.md.
- Email and password only. No OAuth, social login, MFA or passkeys (optional capabilities, not built).
- The mailer is a stub: you must implement NewMailer before production, and the server refuses to start in production without one.
- Production-profile status is not claimed for Gin: the adapter has had no review except its author's. The sign-offs below are self-assessed, and no independent security audit has been done.

## Reproduce

```bash
pnpm build
pnpm --filter @selfauth/conformance coverage:report
pnpm --filter @selfauth/playground-gin test        # runs every case; set TEST_DATABASE_URL for PostgreSQL
```
